findings.quote: // An overlay open when this reply landed would otherwise survive
findings.what: Both edited functions also handle refreshing a pane that is already open (they carry the view, env cursor, list view and edits across), so the unconditional `self.keymap_open = false` also dismisses a help overlay the operator raised over an existing pane when a refresh reply lands, although the body is not replaced by a different one.
